notes: 配置同步面板新增「工作区显示」卡片：工作区三态切换（显示 / 隐藏会话 / 归档工作区），展开后逐个隐藏 / 显示会话；工作区与会话独立操作，写入本机 DSH 的两套原生状态文件，不依赖 session-manager API。
notesEn: New "Workspace visibility" card in the config-sync panel: switch a workspace between visible / sessions-hidden / archived, expand to hide/show individual sessions. Workspaces and sessions are independent; writes the two native DSH state files directly (no session-manager API).
